clue.text: Vessel found in the kitchen bin, perhaps

definitions.meaning: a vessel is a ship, here a large passenger ocean ship

definitions.text: found in the kitchen bin, perhaps
definitions.meaning: a plastic bag fitted inside a rubbish bin to keep it clean

explanation.definitionFit: One word names both an ocean-going passenger ship and the bag lining a rubbish bin.

clue.text: Fed up with tea-break? Just the reverse

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word Fed is read from bottom to top
to break the word tea is to shatter its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone tired of their tea-break is told the opposite is true.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns FED into DEF; 'break' rearranges TEA into EAT. 'Just the reverse' looks like an instruction to swap things, but 'reverse' is the definition, a setback.
explanation.definitionFit: A reverse is a setback or loss in battle or sport, the same as being beaten.

clue.text: Union without a single member

parts.note: a union that has no single person in it, read as wedlock, whose two partners stop being single

explanation.definitionFit: Wedlock is a union of two people, and once inside it neither partner is single any longer.

clue.text: Note answer in book

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
to serve is to answer, as in 'that will answer the purpose'

explanation.surface: A memo with a reply is tucked inside a volume.
explanation.definitionFit: To book a table or seat is to arrange to hold it in advance.

clue.text: Challenged champion's delay about the final

definitions.note: read as 'challenged champion is', the clue's 's standing for is

indicators.note: about means the word for delay sits around the word for the final

parts.note: to defer is to delay or postpone
the end is the final part of anything

explanation.surface: A title holder put off their final match.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's on 'champion's' stands for 'is', linking definition to wordplay; 'about' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: The title holder who must fight off a challenger is the one keeping the title.

clue.text: Resolve sectarian differences

indicators.note: differences suggests the letters of sectarian being made different, rearranged

explanation.definitionFit: To resolve a question is to find out for certain, to establish the facts.

clue.text: Coal-seam, perhaps, carrying water-borne hazards

definitions.meaning: a seam of coal is a stratum found in a pit, literally a pit's stratum
a naval ship that lays explosive devices at sea

explanation.definitionFit: Split in two the word is a pit's stratum; whole it is a warship sowing explosives in the water.

clue.text: It's most desirable to enclose a wild animal

indicators.note: to enclose means the word for most desirable goes around the letter a

parts.note: the best is the most desirable

explanation.surface: Keeping a dangerous creature caged is the preferred course.
explanation.definitionFit: A brute or creature of the wild, an untamed four-legged animal.

clue.text: Duck, mate! Here comes a stone!

parts.note: a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, shaped like the letter O
a pal is a mate or friend

explanation.surface: A friend shouts a warning to dodge a rock being thrown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Duck' looks like a warning to dodge, but it is zero, a cricket score of nought.
explanation.definitionFit: This iridescent gemstone is a precious stone, the October birthstone.

clue.text: Get ready for the night

parts.note: not preparing for bed but an actor's preparation for the opening night of a play

explanation.definitionFit: Actors practise their play repeatedly before the first-night performance.

clue.text: Quietly mention favour

parts.note: p is piano, the musical term for quietly
to refer to something is to mention it

explanation.definitionFit: To favour one option over others is to like it more.

clue.text: Turn back before it erupts

indicators.note: turning back means the word for before is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: ante is Latin for before, as in antenatal

explanation.surface: A warning to retreat before a volcano blows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turn back' looks like a warning to flee; it reverses ANTE, Latin for before.
explanation.definitionFit: Mount Etna in Sicily is Europe's most active volcano.

clue.text: Confirm tea laid out after five

indicators.note: after places the rearranged letters following the numeral

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five

indicators.note: out suggests the letters of tea laid being put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone checks that tea has been set out by five o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges TEA LAID into ALIDATE, which comes 'after' V.
explanation.definitionFit: To validate something is to confirm it is genuine or correct.

clue.text: Disorderly actors are plastered

parts.note: rough can mean disorderly or rowdy
the cast is the group of actors in a play

explanation.walkthrough: 'plastered' looks like slang for drunk, which suits the rowdy actors, but it means coated with plaster.
explanation.definitionFit: To coat a wall with a coarse mix of lime and gravel is to give it a rough plaster finish.

clue.text: No simple mental condition

definitions.meaning: not simple, meaning intricate or complicated
a psychological fixation, as in an inferiority one

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an adjective for intricate and a noun for an obsessive psychological state.

clue.text: An event Jews won't forget or ignore

definitions.meaning: the spring festival commemorating the Exodus from Egypt
to skip over or disregard, as two words

explanation.definitionFit: The Jewish festival marking the Exodus shares its spelling with a phrase meaning to disregard.

clue.text: It may pick and hold a lock

definitions.text: It may pick and hold a lock

parts.words: It may pick and hold a lock
parts.note: a bent pin that can be used to pick a door lock and also holds a lock of hair in place

explanation.definitionFit: A U-shaped pin keeps hair in place and is the classic improvised tool for picking a lock.

clue.text: A frenzy of war cries and whirling blades

indicators.note: a frenzy is wild agitation, so the letters of war cries are tossed about

explanation.surface: Battle shouts rise in a frenzy amid spinning swords.
explanation.definitionFit: A propeller on an aircraft is a set of spinning blades.

clue.text: Girl can put up a calendar

parts.note: Alma is a girl's name

indicators.note: in a down entry, put up means the word can is written bottom to top

explanation.surface: A girl is able to hang up a calendar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' looks like hanging the calendar; it reverses CAN to NAC.
explanation.definitionFit: An almanac is a yearly calendar with astronomical and other information.

clue.text: Type of porcelain food container

definitions.meaning: a very thin, delicate kind of china
the outer casing of a hen's egg, holding its food

explanation.definitionFit: The thin casing of an egg gives its name to a very fine, translucent china.

clue.text: They may be jellied or else cooked

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters of else being doctored or rearranged

explanation.surface: A dish is either set in jelly or prepared some other way.
explanation.walkthrough: Jellied eels are a traditional London East End dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Snakelike fish are stewed and set in aspic in the London dish.

clue.text: Harvest a new type of pear

indicators.note: making a new type of the word pear means rearranging its letters

explanation.surface: Gather in a newly bred variety of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: To reap is to cut and gather a crop.

clue.text: A disposition of arms

parts.note: not a military deployment of weapons but a way of holding the limbs, hands on hips and elbows out

explanation.definitionFit: Standing with hands on hips and elbows bent outward is a particular placing of the limbs.

clue.text: Feature of barley, used to make bread

indicators.note: the letters of bread are used to make a different word

explanation.surface: Grain that goes into baking loaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Barley ears bear long bristles, called awns, which together form its whiskery fringe.

clue.text: Train for Rugby, for example

definitions.meaning: Rugby is a famous English public ..., which gave its name to the sport

explanation.definitionFit: To teach is to train; Rugby is a celebrated English place of education.

clue.text: Four in new search for data

indicators.note: in means the numeral goes inside the rearranged letters
new suggests the letters of search being made new by rearranging

parts.note: IV is the Roman numeral for four

explanation.surface: Four people take up a fresh hunt for information.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' makes ARCHES from the fodder, and 'in' signals the numeral going inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Archives are stored collections of records and documents.

clue.text: An embrace for Lady Grey

indicators.note: an embrace means the word an wraps around the pronoun for a lady

parts.note: taken as written
she is the pronoun for a lady

explanation.surface: Someone hugs a titled woman called Lady Grey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lady Grey' reads as a name (and a tea), but splits: 'Lady' is SHE, 'Grey' the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashen means pale grey, the colour of ash.

clue.text: One in the club has whip-round for cheese

indicators.note: round means the word for whip goes around the word for one in the club

parts.note: the cat o' nine tails is a whip, cat for short
a member is one who belongs to a club

explanation.surface: A club member organises a collection to buy cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'whip-round' looks like a collection of money for a gift, but the hyphenated word splits into a piece and a container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft, creamy French cheese from Normandy.
